name: @hl-bos/bte-pipeline
description: Business Transformation Engine (BTE) automated intake pipeline — the deterministic, DB-agnostic core that turns a Business Transformation Digital Intake into an engagement, collects public website evidence, analyzes it with @hl-bos/bti-engine, generates a versioned draft-AI-generated report, and drives the truthful processing state machine. Persistence, notification and delivery are performed through injected adapters that bind to existing HL-BOS primitives (events, discovery, bti, comms, audit); this package invents no tables and delivers nothing to a client on its own.
